face 后直接接宾语；若保留 with 用 be faced with
Young people face difficulties in the job market.
borrow from 借入；lend to 借出
Some people borrow money from family members to buy a home.
People can benefit from effective public services.
Museums can encourage residents to visit more often.
be used to doing = 习惯于做某事
People are used to checking their phones every morning.
Online services provide access to useful information.
waste 作垃圾总称为不可数
Households produce large amounts of waste.
Digital tools make it easier to access information.
Cultural events can attract more tourists.
Better education can support growth in the long term.
Regular exercise may improve sleep quality.
健康/压力主题常见自然搭配
Exercise can relieve stress and improve mood.
dispose of 为固定动词短语
Less waste should be disposed of in landfills.
Individuals should take responsibility for reducing waste.
freshment 不自然；novelty 指新鲜体验
Tourists are attracted by a sense of novelty.
情态动词 + 动词原形
A balanced diet can keep people healthy.
weight 作可数搭配时要用冠词 a
Exercise can help maintain a healthy weight.
information 不可数，正确介词结构 provide A with B
Museums provide visitors with information about local history.
Some older adults are less comfortable using digital devices.
Property prices are high in many cities.
combine 自带结合之意，不需 together
People can combine a healthy diet with regular exercise.
Automation may result in widespread unemployment in routine occupations.
